name: link_list
title: Link List
summary: Titled list of static or query-based links.
description: Titled list of links. Each link is static (page _id + anchor, or url) or a query on collections / posts / taxonomy terms (utility_filter: filter_by, exclude_by, sort, max_items) that expands into one link per result. Any link can open a component in the popup instead ("popup": { component, data, hash }). Used by the footer.
